name: 斑背潛鴨

iucn.assessmentNote: IUCN全球評級；非香港常見度

illustrationTaxon: Aythya marila adult male in breeding plumage; one separate close-up explicitly identifies the female of the same species

similarSpecies.distinction: 鳳頭潛鴨雄鳥體形較緊湊並有明顯後垂羽冠；斑背潛鴨頭圓而無冠，雄鳥脅部純白。
小潛鴨雄鳥頭後有小尖峰、後頂較平；斑背潛鴨頭頂圓。小潛鴨作北美易混種比較，不代表香港出現。

featureNotes: 黑頭帶綠光澤、黃眼及藍灰喙；黑色喙甲較小而呈三角形
繁殖羽雄鳥背肩有細密灰白蟲紋
雄鳥脅部純白，與藍黑胸及黑色後體對比
同種雌鳥：喙基白斑較大，脅羽帶灰色

rangeMap.note: Greater Scaup breeds across the Holarctic at high latitudes and winters along North Pacific and Atlantic coasts, northwest Europe, the Black and Caspian Seas and east Asia south to southeast China. Highlighted countries are a selective native-range overview only: green never means the whole country is occupied; it is neither a complete distribution nor a seasonal/occurrence polygon. Hong Kong is a rare winter visitor locality, not an IUCN rarity category.

sources.use: Full page read: 40–51 cm; Hong Kong Category I rare winter visitor concentrated in Deep Bay; adult male green-glossed dark head, blue-black chest, fine grey-white vermiculation on mantle and pure white flanks; female grey-tinged flanks and large white bill-base patch; adult eclipse duller; Greater Scaup has rounder larger head and no tuft compared with Tufted Duck; Holarctic breeding and coastal/east Asian winter distribution; global IUCN LC, trend decreasing.
Full page read for Tufted Duck comparison: compact shape and crest; male black-and-white with yellow eye; female dark brown with smaller variable bill-base white and broad black bill tip.

Full identification page read: Lesser Scaup adult male black-and-white with finely barred back, bluish bill and yellow eye; small rear crown peak with flatter back of head distinguishes it from Greater Scaup; white wing stripe usually does not reach primaries. Used only for a clearly labelled North American comparison, not Hong Kong occurrence.
Global IUCN assessment page: Least Concern, population trend decreasing; assessed 2018. IUCN status is not Hong Kong abundance.
